---
title: "05_analysis_1: Patient, control and lesion expression"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## Intention

input file: 03_dat_aug.tsv\
output files: results/05_rel_expr_grid.png, results/05_lesions_vs_controls.png

Loading the libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

Load the augmented data and make it long (one row per sample per gene)

```{r}
data_aug <- read_tsv(here("data/03_dat_aug.tsv"))

data_long <- data_aug |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Sample, Tissue_type, Group, Tissue, Lesion_type, Plot_group),
               names_to = "Gene",
               values_to = "Expression")

dir.create(here("results"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Plot 1: Patient vs. control in endometrium and peritoneum

Relative expression = expression minus the control mean of the same tissue (CE for endometrium, CP for peritoneum).

```{r}
rel_expr <- data_long |>
  filter(Tissue != "Lesion") |>
  group_by(Gene, Tissue) |>
  mutate(Rel_expr = Expression - mean(Expression[Group == "Control"], na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup()

top_genes <- rel_expr |>
  filter(Group == "Patient") |>
  group_by(Tissue, Gene) |>
  summarise(Mean_rel_expr = mean(Rel_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop_last") |>
  slice_max(abs(Mean_rel_expr), n = 10) |>
  pull(Gene) |>
  unique()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10
rel_expr_plot <- rel_expr |>
  filter(Gene %in% top_genes) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Tissue,
             y = Rel_expr,
             fill = Group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5,
               alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene,
             scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Patient vs. control expression in endometrium and peritoneum",
       subtitle = "Top 10 most changed genes per tissue, relative to the control mean of the same tissue",
       x = "Tissue",
       y = "Relative expression (log fold change vs. control)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

rel_expr_plot

ggsave(here("results/05_rel_expr_grid.png"),
       plot = rel_expr_plot,
       width = 14,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

## Plot 2: Lesions vs. controls

Genes are chosen where the lesions differ from both CE and CP in the same direction, ranked by the smaller of the two differences.

```{r}
top_genes_lesion <- data_long |>
  group_by(Gene) |>
  summarise(Diff_vs_CE = mean(Expression[Tissue == "Lesion"], na.rm = TRUE) -
                         mean(Expression[Tissue_type == "CE"], na.rm = TRUE),
            Diff_vs_CP = mean(Expression[Tissue == "Lesion"], na.rm = TRUE) -
                         mean(Expression[Tissue_type == "CP"], na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  filter(sign(Diff_vs_CE) == sign(Diff_vs_CP)) |>
  slice_max(pmin(abs(Diff_vs_CE), abs(Diff_vs_CP)), n = 20) |>
  pull(Gene)

rel_expr_lesion <- data_long |>
  filter(Gene %in% top_genes_lesion) |>
  group_by(Gene) |>
  mutate(Rel_expr = Expression - mean(Expression[Tissue_type == "CE"], na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 11
lesion_plot <- rel_expr_lesion |>
  mutate(Plot_group = factor(Plot_group,
                             levels = c("Control endometrium", "Patient endometrium",
                                        "Control peritoneum", "Patient peritoneum",
                                        "Peritoneal lesion", "Ovarian endometrioma",
                                        "Deep infiltrating"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Plot_group,
             y = Rel_expr,
             fill = Tissue)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5,
               alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene,
             scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Endometriosis lesions compared with control tissues",
       subtitle = "Top 20 genes where lesions differ from both control endometrium and control peritoneum",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Relative expression (log fold change vs. control endometrium)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

lesion_plot

ggsave(here("results/05_lesions_vs_controls.png"),
       plot = lesion_plot,
       width = 15,
       height = 11,
       dpi = 300)
```
